messages:
oncall-anna: Starting an incident thread — KMS rotation jobs for Private VPC customers in eu-west1 are failing and returning 503s for inference/embeddings. Spinning up investigation. Incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2005123456

infra-ben: Observed a ~14% 5xx spike across private tenants in eu-west1 over the last 10m. Affected: ~12 customers (various dedicated/private deployments). Sample log: 
`ERROR kms:rotate: failed to fetch new key material: access denied`

platform-carlos: I rolled back the scheduled rotation job at 2005123500 and started manual reconcile for the impacted VPCs. Will requeue per-customer rotations only after green checks.

security-lee: Looking into audit logs now — preliminary signal shows partner service account tokens expired during rotation window. Raising with partner ops and checking IAM policy changes.

oncall-anna: Posted an initial customer note to the affected accounts list and flagged support for one-off escalation. Internal playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/kms-rotations-playbook

sre-bot: ALERT: private-deploy smoke tests failing (6/10). Failing step: key fetch stage.

infra-ben: Running targeted logs and a quick command dump: 
```
kubectl -n redwood-system logs deployment/kms-rotation-worker | tail -n 50
# shows repeated 403/403-like errors from partner auth service
```

platform-carlos: Mitigations in place: 1) rollback rotation job 2) trigger manual key reconcile for impacted VPCs 3) temporarily extend retry/backoff and add circuit breaker to per-tenant rotation. Monitoring shows error rate trending down.

security-lee: Root cause hypothesis: partner token TTL shorter than our rotation window + no pre-rotation token health check. Recommending: pre-rotation token validation step and backoff on 4xx from KMS proxy.

oncall-anna: ETA to full recovery ~60-90m. Updating status page and customer comms. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

infra-ben: Errors down to ~0.6% after manual reconcile and targeted retries. There are still a couple of VPCs being reconciled. Continuing to monitor for 30m before declaring resolved.

platform-carlos: Post-incident actions: schedule RCA, add pre-rotation check, add partner token alarm to avoid silent expiry, and add a canary rotation run in eu-west1. Owners: infra-ben, security-lee, platform-carlos.

oncall-anna: Incident resolved at 2005123900 — rotation retries completed, key provisioning stable, and customer traffic restored to normal. Will circulate full incident summary + timeline in ~2h. Thanks to everyone who jumped in. :white_check_mark:
